newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler studies internal Mercedes merger - sources.
newsitem.headline: Daimler studies internal Mercedes merger - sources.

text.p: German industrial holding giant Daimler-Benz AG is considering a plan under which its Mercedes-Benz automotive unit would be fully integrated into the parent company, sources said on Thursday.
Daimler-Benz chief Juergen Schrempp said earlier this year he was studying a restructuring of the Daimler group, with likely management changes, to make it more responsive and to boost quality.
An internal "merger" of the Mercedes-Benz car- and truck-making units would also likely be accompanied by increased representation by Mercedes executives on the Daimler board, the sources said.
They added that the general outline of this plan was currently being discussed within the Daimler board and had found a large degree of acceptance.
The sources had no information on widespread speculation that Mercedes-Benz chairman Helmut Werner opposed the plan despite the offer of a senior position on the main Daimler board.
Schrempp said in late September that he was hoping to have made a decision on restructuring the company by the end of this year.
